Tests that streaming requests bypass cache entirely

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go/v2"
)

func main() {
	req := pkg.ChatCompletionRequest{
		Model: `gpt-4`,
		Messages: []pkg.Message{
			pkg.Message{Role: `user`, User: &pkg.UserMessage{
				Content: pkg.UserContent(`"Hello"`),
			}},
		},
	}
	client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClientFromJSON(`{"api_key":"your-api-key","cache":{"backend":"memory","max_entries":256,"ttl_seconds":300}}`)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	result, err := client.ChatStreamWithContext(context.Background(), req)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	for resultChunk := range result.Chan() {
		fmt.Printf("%+v\n", resultChunk)
	}
	if err := result.Err(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
```
